author: DAILY FOOTBALL BEAT
title: The Daily predicts Week 8 football games
text:
On a gloomy Saturday afternoon at Michigan Stadium, commotion was set off in the press box around 5 p.m. All the media members around us, including myself (Jordan Klein), took out their phones to alert X, formerly known as Twitter, of the news. Freshman quarterback Tommy Carr was taking snaps from junior center Jake Guarnera, indicating he was likely to come in for the second half.
I immediately took to X and alerted my followers of the news. I thought I was first. But to my dismay, I saw minutes later that the great Angelique Chengelis posted a video of Carr taking snaps from Guarnera. My post was blown out of the water. I’ve got a lot to learn in that respect — but not when it comes to making picks.
I’ll remain in first place in the football beat’s picks following Week 8. Sharpie.
